scenarios.context: A mother wakes up her son before school.

speakerA.en: Wake up, Reza! It's seven o'clock, and you have to get up now.
No way. Turn off your alarm and put on your uniform.
Look under the bed. And hurry up, because the bus leaves in twenty minutes.
Of course. Pick up your bag, and don't forget to switch off the light.

speakerB.en: Five more minutes, Mum. I stayed up late last night.
Okay, okay. Where are my socks? I can't find them anywhere.
Found them! Can I take a sandwich with me? I don't have time for breakfast.
Done. See you this afternoon. Bye!

scenarios.context: A customer asks a shop assistant for help.

speakerA.en: Excuse me, I'm looking for a jacket for the winter. Can you help me out?
Medium, I think. Can I try this one on?
It's a bit tight. Do you have a bigger size? I'd like to try it on again.
No, thanks. I'll look around in other shops and come back if I don't find one.

speakerB.en: Certainly. What size do you take?
Of course. The changing rooms are over there, next to the shoes.
Let me check. Oh, we've run out of medium, but I can order one for you.
No problem. Take this card, and call us if you change your mind.

speakerA.en: Can you help me cook dinner, Pouya? Mum is coming home late.
Cut up the onions, and I'll heat up the oil in the pan.
Not yet. Wait until the water boils, then turn the heat down a little.
Yes, on the second shelf. After dinner, we have to wash up and clean up the kitchen.

speakerB.en: Sure. What should I do first?
Done. Should I put the pasta in the water now?
I think we've run out of salt. Is there more in the cupboard?
Fine, but you wash, and I'll dry. That's only fair.

scenarios.context: Two friends plan a trip to a museum.

speakerA.en: Let's go to the science museum on Saturday. Can you find out when it opens?
Great. How much does it cost? I need to work out if I have enough money.
Then it's cheap enough. Shall I set up a meeting with the others?
Okay, I'll ask Sina instead. We should meet outside the station at half past eight.

speakerB.en: I'll look it up online right now. It opens at nine.
Students pay half price. We just have to show our school cards.
Yes, but don't ask Tara. She gave up going out last month because of her exams.
Perfect. I'll call you if anything comes up.

scenarios.context: A girl asks her father for help with a broken machine.

speakerA.en: Dad, the washing machine has broken down again. It won't turn on.
Yes, it's in. I tried to switch it on three times, but nothing happens.
Can they come today? We've run out of clean clothes.
Thanks, Dad. I'll put the wet clothes in a bag and get everything ready.

speakerB.en: Did you check the plug? Maybe it came out of the socket.
Then we'll have to call somebody. I'll look for the repair shop's number.
I'll ask. If they can't, we'll take the clothes to Grandma's house.
Good girl. Let's sort it out together before your mother gets back.
